name: 音声スペクトル解析
algorithm: Audio Spectral Analysis — Frequency Domain Analyzer
mechanism:
This method performs spectral analysis of audio signals for detecting AI-generated speech following Chen et al. (2020):

1. **Short-Timeフーリエ変換(STFT)**: The audio signal is windowed and transformed to produce a spectrogram. The time-frequency representation reveals the full spectral content of the speech signal, including harmonics, formants, and noise components.

2. **スペクトルEnvelope分析**: The spectral envelope (smoothed magnitude spectrum) is extracted per frame using cepstral methods. Natural speech exhibits specific spectral envelope shapes determined by vocal tract resonances. AI vocoders (WaveNet, HiFi-GAN) may produce spectral envelopes with subtle artifacts — missing spectral detail above certain frequencies or unnatural smoothness in spectral transitions.

3. **High-周波数Content評価**: Frequencies above 8 kHz are particularly informative for deepfake detection. Natural speech contains aperiodic high-frequency energy from fricatives and aspiration noise with specific spectral characteristics. Many AI voice synthesis systems produce truncated or artificially shaped high-frequency content, revealing the synthesis methodology.

4. **Mel-周波数分析**: The spectrum is analyzed on the mel scale to capture perceptually relevant features. Mel-frequency cepstral coefficients (MFCCs) and their delta/delta-delta derivatives are computed. AI-generated speech often shows statistical anomalies in MFCC distributions — particularly in higher-order coefficients capturing spectral detail.

5. **スペクトルFlux&Continuity**: Frame-to-frame spectral changes (spectral flux) are measured. Natural speech shows characteristic flux patterns during phoneme transitions. AI-generated speech may exhibit unnaturally smooth spectral evolution or micro-discontinuities between vocoder frames, serving as detection indicators.
parameters:
分析タイプ: 周波数
メディア: 動画

出力: 信頼度スコア (0-100)

accuracy: 中〜高 — 70-88% 単独精度. Most effective when combined with other 動画 forensic methods. Performance depends on 動画 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 動画 through audio spectral analysis analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 動画 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 動画 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 動画 forensic methods

limitations:
